title: Aetherius Blueprint
description: The declarative instruction file executed by Aetherius. Language-agnostic source of truth shared by the Python core and every SDK.

inputs.description: Declared, typed parameters that make the Blueprint reusable.

secrets.description: Names of runtime-only secrets. Values are injected at execution and never stored in the file.

vars.description: Local constants (domains, paths) available for interpolation.

provider.description: Cognition backend: claude (default, [cognition] extra) or local ([vision] extra, on-device grounder).

model.description: Model name, not backend: an Anthropic model id for claude, a local asset name@version for local.

goal.description: High-level objective for Phantom (Act IV) when the run is not fully scripted.

steps.description: The ordered action sequence (the action dictionary).

outputs.description: Shape of the returned data, via interpolation of step results.

debug.description: Visible browser + cursor overlay + slow-mo for browser Acts; structured terminal logs otherwise.

agent.description: Phantom (Act IV) guardrails; ignored by the other Acts.

max_steps.description: Upper bound on the perceive->reason->act loop: the agent fails cleanly if the goal is not reached within this many steps.

proxy.description: Network identity (Jalon G). Routes both engines through a proxy, rotates the exit IP, prevents the WebRTC leak, and keeps the fingerprint's geography coherent. Credentials are never stored: pass them via {{ secrets.x }}.

oneOf.description: A proxy URL (scheme://[user:pass@]host:port) or a {{ secrets.x }} that renders one.

url.description: A single proxy (or rotating gateway) URL.

rotate.description: Rotation strategy across runs. Default per_run.

geo.description: Exit-IP country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. FR) to align timezone/locale/languages with.

impersonate.description: TLS impersonation target for Vector (JA3/JA4), e.g. "chrome"; true means chrome. Requires the [network] extra.

stealth.description: Modular discretion. Off by default; a preset name; or an inline configuration.

step.description: A single action. Parameters depend on the action; extra properties are allowed and validated per-action by the engine. Act III+ adds 'read' (semantic extraction: 'vision' description plus optional 'schema' object shaping the reply).

when.description: Guard expression rendered before dispatch; the step is skipped unless it yields true/1/yes.

target.description: Unified target of an interactive action. Either the drop selector of drag (string), or an object aiming at a DOM selector ({selector, selector_type}) or, on Act III+, at a natural-language description resolved by vision grounding ({vision}). Top-level 'selector' and 'target' are mutually exclusive on a step.

oneOf.description: drag only: selector to drop onto.

vision.description: Natural-language description of the on-screen element (Act III+).

selector.description: DOM selector (nested form of the top-level 'selector').

then.description: Steps run when an if condition holds.

else.description: Steps run when an if condition does not hold.

steps.description: Nested steps for repeat and for_each.
